final_message:
The root cause is in `refund_invoice` in `billing/refunds.py`. It looked up payments with the wrong ID, so it never found the customer's successful charge and raised the error.

**Root cause:** `successful_payments(ctx, invoice_id)` in `billing/payments.py` looks up payments by invoice ID. `refund_invoice` called it with `invoice["customer_id"]`. No payment has a matching invoice ID, so the list came back empty. The refund then reached the "no successful payment" check even though the charge had succeeded.

**Fix:** I changed the call to `successful_payments(ctx, invoice_id)`, a one-line change in `billing/refunds.py`.

**Regression test:** `tests/test_refunds.py` subscribes a customer, pays the invoice, refunds it, and checks the credit note and the payment's refunded state. It fails on the old code with the reported `InvalidStateError` and passes with the fix. The full suite passes (25 tests), run with `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q`.

**Answer file:** `answer.json` in the repo root contains `{"file": "refunds.py", "function": "refund_invoice"}`.

Nothing is committed. The changes are the one-line fix, the new test file, and `answer.json`.

steps.command: git ls-files && grep -rn "no successful payment" --include=*.py . | grep -v .venv
grep -rn "successful payment\|InvalidStateError" billing tests; echo ---; cat billing/refunds.py
cat billing/payments.py; echo ---; grep -n "def payments_for\|def successful\|payments" billing/store.py; echo ---; sed -n 195,230p billing/invoices.py
grep -rn "successful_payments" billing tests; echo ---; .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -15
grep -rn "refund" tests | head -30; echo ---; sed -n 1,60p tests/test_credit_notes.py
cat tests/conftest.py; echo ---; grep -rn "collect\|pay" tests | head; echo ---; grep -n "def " billing/engine.py | head -40

cat > tests/test_refunds.py <<'EOF'
from billing import refunds


def test_refund_paid_invoice_returns_charged_amount(world):
    cus = world.customer()
    world.engine.subscribe(cus["id"], [(world.monthly["id"], 1)])
    [inv] = world.engine.invoices_for(cus["id"])
    assert inv["status"] == "paid"
    note = refunds.refund_invoice(world.ctx, inv["id"])
    assert note["amount"] == inv["total"]
    assert note["refunded"] is True
    payments = world.ctx.store.payments_for_invoice(inv["id"])
    assert [p["status"] for p in payments] == ["refunded"]
    assert payments[0]["refunded_amount"] == inv["total"]
EOF
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -30
git stash push -q billing/refunds.py && .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_refunds.py 2>&1 | tail -4; git stash pop -q && git diff --stat
